name: QuNexus
summary: Three-port family with legacy unnamed ports and newer named ports. Bootloader is distinguished by PID MSB rather than a dedicated bootloader PID.

notes: Application PID was 25 prior to named-port support; current firmware (QuNexus_Firmware/code/USB/USB_Descriptor.h) reports 24. Corrected 2026-07-28 - this file previously still listed 25.

Real-hardware finding (2026-08-26, macOS): without these, --fw-update QuNexus failed twice per run - 'NO REPLY within 100 ms' after chunk 1 on the first attempt (the retry then sailed through all 321 chunks), and 'NO REPLY within 500 ms' after the final chunk (321/321), before the app-port fallback confirmed the update landed. Same two device behaviors as SoftStep/BopPad (see softstep.json / boppad.json).

firstGapDelayMs (5000): the bootloader erases its whole application region when it recognizes the first firmware packet, blocking USB until that finishes - so chunk 1's reply can't come within the 100ms steady-state -cd. The first attempt times out on chunk 1 and only 'works' because that failed attempt already triggered the erase, so the retry finds it done. 5000ms lets the FIRST attempt wait it out and land on attempt 1. It's a return-early timeout (spent only if the reply is genuinely slow), so the generous value has no steady-state cost; confirm the real erase duration with --timestamp and tighten if desired.

rebootsToAppOnFinalChunk (true): QuNexus reboots straight into application mode as it commits the final chunk, so it never answers an identity request on the bootloader port afterwards. Skip the doomed final-chunk handshake and let runAutomaticUpdate's application-port reconnect + version check be the success test - avoids ~4s (postDelayMs timeout + 3s retry) of waiting for a reply that structurally cannot come.

chunkDelayMs/postDelayMs left at CLI defaults (100/500): chunks 2-320 reply fine at 100ms, and with rebootsToAppOnFinalChunk the final chunk no longer waits postDelayMs for a reply - postDelayMs is now just the brief settle after the last F7 before the port closes and we probe the app port.
Requests a reboot into bootloader mode for QuNexus devices.
Single monolithic SysEx message, not Hex_to_SysEx-chunked. Superseded by firmware_2_2_0_cs512 - kept until the chunked payload is hardware-validated.
Boot-tare capture for stuck keys, fixed pressure/bend/CC zeroing out at positive per-key sensitivity.
Bootloader family matching remains passive first, then is confirmed by PID MSB = 1.
